## Role glossary

### A

**Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)**  
A tree representation of an expression or program. Transforming the tree rather than the text keeps every change structurally valid.  
*Projects:* [16 Expression Complexity Engine](../../projects/16-algorithmic-expression-complexity-engine/profile.md)  

**Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (HLS)**  
Video split into short segments at several quality levels so each viewer's player can switch quality to match their connection.  
*Projects:* [13 Livestreaming Platform](../../projects/13-low-latency-event-broadcast-platform/profile.md), [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](../../projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md)  

### E

**Ephemeral Toolchain**  
Running build tools inside throwaway containers so nothing is installed on the host and every run starts from the same state.  
*Projects:* [23 Shopify Storefront Engine](../../projects/23-containerized-ecommerce-design-system/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](../../projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

### H

**Host-Based Routing**  
Serving different sites or tenants from one deployment by reading the requested hostname.  
*Projects:* [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](../../projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)  

### S

**Server-Sent Events (SSE)**  
A one-way stream from server to browser over plain HTTP, used for live dashboards without WebSocket overhead.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

**Server-Side Rendering (SSR)**  
Rendering pages on the server so they load fast and index well, then hydrating them in the browser when needed.  
*Projects:* [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](../../projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](../../projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [25 MEEN Full-Stack Scaffold](../../projects/25-monolithic-relational-fullstack-scaffold/profile.md)  

### V

**Voice Stealing**  
Reassigning the oldest or quietest synth voice when polyphony runs out, avoiding CPU spikes and audible clicks.  
*Projects:* [15 Web Audio Synthesizer](../../projects/15-web-audio-dsp-modular-synthesizer/profile.md)  

### W

**Web Audio API**  
The browser's built-in audio engine, which runs node graphs on a dedicated real-time thread.  
*Projects:* [15 Web Audio Synthesizer](../../projects/15-web-audio-dsp-modular-synthesizer/profile.md)  

**Web GIS (Leaflet)**  
Interactive maps in the browser built on open map data, without a paid map vendor.  
*Projects:* [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](../../projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md)  

### Z

**Zod Runtime Contracts**  
Validating data shapes at runtime in TypeScript so a malformed event is rejected at the boundary instead of breaking the UI.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)
